title: Paper 1 scope and epistemic boundary frozen
research_question: What is the first paper entitled to claim, and what must remain outside its evidential scope?
before_state: The project had a broad Zi Wei system-building ambition, with a risk that formalization, predictive validity, and physical ontology could be conflated.
result: The accepted project constitution, frozen decisions, outline and manuscript snapshot define Paper 1 as source-grounded Zhongzhou-school formalization and internal reproducibility work, not a claim of real-world predictive or causal validity.
key_insights: The scope is bounded to Zhongzhou-school material; other schools are not mixed into the canonical core.
Qi is operationalized as a latent-state representation, not an empirically established physical energy.
No arbitrary empirical continuous weights are allowed before system identification.
Internal fidelity and reproducibility do not establish external predictive validity.
negative_findings: The inspected manuscript is a draft snapshot and cannot serve as independent validation of its own quantitative claims.

boundaries.source_status: Explicitly stated in accepted project-method artifacts; not a claim that classical sources establish a modern scientific theory.
boundaries.implementation_status: Scope and model design specified; full source corpus and implementation closure remain separate work.
boundaries.internal_fidelity: Not evaluated by this scope record.
boundaries.empirical_status: No real-world predictive-validity result is established by this event.

artifacts.label: Manuscript v0.1 snapshot
artifacts.note: Working manuscript only; not independent evidence of its own quantitative statements.

authority_notes: This event records the accepted project scope. It does not certify that every planned implementation or evaluation has been completed.
